question: Can one common timeout tuple be admitted against all paths of a supplied finite bounded path set using max_pi W_pi <= B, and can per-path-only checking admit a tuple without certification of another feasible path?
phase_candidates: all 7^3 phase-domain triples union all 255 constant triples; deduplicate to 591
common_budget: B=max_{q in {2,4,8}} B0(q)+32 = 1249, fixed before execution
hardware_mapping: Same two-client service contract and at most eight dedicated clean receiver slots; each bounded branch/input q activates only its first q slots. The q-dependent loops generate the supplied complete model instruction path; no cache-state join is performed.
admission: Every candidate uses one common K tuple and common fixed-maintenance subset across all paths; robust admissible iff every per-path analysis bound <= common B, equivalently max_q W_q <= B.
training_coverage: Execute every candidate on every supplied path, even inadmissible candidates, retaining each bound and execution;1611candidates x3paths=4833trainingexecutions.
selection: Within fixed/phase families minimize (max path joint completion, max path receiver completion, max path WU packets, K tuple, flush subset) among robustly admitted candidates. Deploy phase only if its worst training joint is strictly lower than the best fixed; fixed wins ties.
freeze: Persist FROZEN_SELECTION.json before any held-out executions. No selection update after validation.
validation_coverage: All3paths x3gaps x2tickphases for both frozen best fixed and frozen best phase (if admitted);36executions. Deployed mode reuses its family result.
mutation: Report all candidates accepted by q2-only W<=B but rejected by the all-path maximum. Choose one deterministic witness with smallest q2 joint completion then candidate ID, freeze it, and verify its other path executions; distinguish uncertified bound from actual overrun.
scope: Author-side executable validation of finite-path aggregation, not automatic CFG extraction, processor WCET certification, abstract-state joining, finite replacement, native gem5, or performance evidence from a real application. Supplied path set must cover every feasible program path before its max bound certifies the whole program.

git_lf_export.transformation: Text LF serialization only; rehash normalized inputs; original experimental plan and all metrics unchanged.
